get_user.title: Get the current user
get_user.description: Read the authenticated Bitly user: login, name, emails, 2FA/SSO state and default_group_guid. Call this first to find the group to shorten links in; use list_groups to see all groups.

default_group_guid.description: Group used when none is given.

update_user.title: Update the current user
update_user.description: Change the authenticated user's display name or default group. Returns the updated user. Only the fields you pass are changed.

default_group_guid.description: GUID of the group to make the default for new links.

get_platform_limits.title: Get API platform limits
get_platform_limits.description: List the API rate/platform limits that apply to the current user, per endpoint and method, with current counts. Filter to one endpoint with path. For plan (subscription) limits use get_plan_limits.

path.description: Only the limits for this API path, e.g. /v4/shorten.

platform_limits.description: Each with endpoint and methods [{name, limit, count}].

get_plan_limits.title: Get plan limits
get_plan_limits.description: List an organization's subscription plan limits (links per month, custom domains, QR codes, etc.) with the current usage count of each. For API rate limits use get_platform_limits.

plan_limits.description: Each with name, description, limit and count.

get_group_feature_usage.title: Get group feature usage
get_group_feature_usage.description: Read a group's current usage against its plan's feature limits (e.g. encodes, QR codes). Optionally narrow to one limit name.

group_guid.description: Group GUID (from list_groups or get_user's default_group_guid).

name.description: Only this limit name, as reported by this tool unfiltered.

get_group_historical_usage.title: Get group historical usage
get_group_historical_usage.description: Read a group's usage of a plan limit over a date range, bucketed by day, week or month. Limit names come from get_group_feature_usage.

group_guid.description: Group GUID (from list_groups or get_user's default_group_guid).

name.description: Limit name to report, e.g. encodes.

unit.description: Bucket size.

historical_limit_usage.description: Each with name and usage rows.

list_organizations.title: List organizations
list_organizations.description: List the Bitly organizations the user belongs to, with guid, name, tier and role. Organization GUIDs are needed for webhooks, plan limits and shorten counts.

include_all.description: Return every organization of the user, ignoring the token's allowed_orgs restriction.

organizations.description: Each with guid, name, tier, role, bsds, is_active.

get_organization.title: Get an organization
get_organization.description: Read one organization's name, tier, role, branded short domains (bsds) and SSO/2FA requirements.

get_organization_shorten_counts.title: Get organization shorten counts
get_organization_shorten_counts.description: Count how many links were shortened across an organization per time bucket. For a per-group split of the current month use get_organization_shorten_counts_by_group.

unit.description: Time bucket the window is measured in.

units.description: How many units back from unit_reference to cover; -1 means all available history.

unit_reference.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the window ends at, e.g. 2025-01-31T00:00:00+0000. Defaults to now.

metrics.description: Rows of {key: date, value: count}.

get_organization_shorten_counts_by_group.title: Get organization shorten counts by group
get_organization_shorten_counts_by_group.description: Count links shortened in each group of an organization for the current month.

metrics.description: Rows of {key: group_guid, value: count}.

list_groups.title: List groups
list_groups.description: List the groups (workspaces that own links) the user can access, optionally only one organization's. Returns each group's guid, name, role and branded domains.

groups.description: Each with guid, name, organization_guid, role, bsds, is_active.

get_group.title: Get a group
get_group.description: Read one group's name, organization, role and branded short domains.

group_guid.description: Group GUID (from list_groups or get_user's default_group_guid).

update_group.title: Update a group
update_group.description: Rename a group, move it to another organization, or set its branded short domains (bsds). Returns the updated group.

group_guid.description: Group GUID (from list_groups or get_user's default_group_guid).

organization_guid.description: Organization to move the group to.

bsds.description: Branded short domains the group may use, e.g. ["example.co"].

get_group_preferences.title: Get group preferences
get_group_preferences.description: Read a group's preferences, chiefly domain_preference: the default domain new links in the group are shortened on.

group_guid.description: Group GUID (from list_groups or get_user's default_group_guid).

update_group_preferences.title: Update group preferences
update_group_preferences.description: Set a group's default short domain (domain_preference), e.g. a branded domain, so shorten_link uses it when no domain is passed.

group_guid.description: Group GUID (from list_groups or get_user's default_group_guid).

domain_preference.description: Domain to use by default, e.g. bit.ly or example.co.

list_group_tags.title: List a group's tags
list_group_tags.description: List the tags in use in a group (up to 1000), for links or for QR codes. Useful before filtering list_bitlinks or bulk-tagging.

group_guid.description: Group GUID (from list_groups or get_user's default_group_guid).

export_group_csv.title: Export group data as CSV
export_group_csv.description: Build a CSV export for a group synchronously and return it inline as a base64 data URI. export_type picks the shape: links_list (link roster), qr_codes_list (QR roster) or link_engagements_batch (engagement metrics for the given bitlinks or filter). Read-only: nothing is changed.

group_guid.description: Group GUID (from list_groups or get_user's default_group_guid).

bitlinks.description: Bitlink ids (domain/hash) to include, for link_engagements_batch.

unix_from.description: Start of the metrics range, Unix seconds UTC.

unix_to.description: End of the metrics range, Unix seconds UTC.

include_metrics.description: On links_list/qr_codes_list, append clicks, scans and button_clicks columns (caps rows at 200).

tags.description: Filter: only items with these tags.

filter_domain.description: Filter: only links on this domain.

created_after.description: Filter: created at or after this Unix time.

created_before.description: Filter: created before this Unix time.

campaign_guid.description: Filter: only links in this campaign.

data_uri.description: base64 data: URI of the CSV.

get_group_shorten_counts.title: Get group shorten counts
get_group_shorten_counts.description: Count links shortened in a group per time bucket.

group_guid.description: Group GUID (from list_groups or get_user's default_group_guid).

unit.description: Time bucket the window is measured in.

unit_reference.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the window ends at, e.g. 2025-01-31T00:00:00+0000. Defaults to now.

metrics.description: Rows of {key: date, value: count}.

shorten_link.title: Shorten a URL
shorten_link.description: Shorten a long URL into a Bitlink and return it. Re-shortening the same URL in the same group returns the existing Bitlink unless force_new_link is set. For a title, tags, custom back-half or expiration in one call use create_bitlink.

long_url.description: The URL to shorten, including https://.

domain.description: Short domain to use, e.g. bit.ly or a branded domain. Defaults to the group's preference.

group_guid.description: Group to create the link in. Defaults to the user's default group.

force_new_link.description: Always create a new Bitlink even if this URL was already shortened.

create_bitlink.title: Create a Bitlink with details
create_bitlink.description: Shorten a URL and set its title, tags, custom keyword (back-half), deeplinks, expiration and dynamic routing in one call; or add a keyword override to an existing Bitlink via bitlink_id. Returns the Bitlink. For a plain shorten use shorten_link.

long_url.description: The URL to shorten. Required unless bitlink_id is given.

bitlink_id.description: Existing Bitlink id (domain/hash) to add a keyword override to; do not combine with long_url.

domain.description: Short domain, e.g. bit.ly or a branded domain.

group_guid.description: Group to create the link in.

keyword.description: Custom back-half; creates domain/keyword (requires a branded domain on most plans).

expiration_at.description: Expiry timestamp, e.g. 2025-01-28T14:30:00+0000 (at least 5 minutes ahead).

force_new_link.description: Always create a new Bitlink even if this URL was already shortened.

deeplinks.description: Mobile app deeplinks: objects {app_id, app_uri_path, install_url, install_type}.

dynamic_routing.description: Routing rules: objects {long_url, country_match, country_exclude, region_match, region_exclude, device_match, device_exclude, os_match, os_exclude}.

get_bitlink.title: Get a Bitlink
get_bitlink.description: Read one Bitlink's destination, title, tags, custom back-halves, QR codes, campaigns and expiry.

domain.description: Domain part of the Bitlink id (the text before the slash), e.g. bit.ly or a branded domain like example.co.

hash.description: Hash part of the Bitlink id (the text after the slash), e.g. 3xYzAbc for bit.ly/3xYzAbc.

expand_bitlink.title: Expand a Bitlink
expand_bitlink.description: Resolve a Bitlink id (domain/hash) to its long URL without needing it to be in your account. Read-only. For full metadata of your own link use get_bitlink.

bitlink_id.description: The Bitlink id, domain/hash, e.g. bit.ly/3xYzAbc (no scheme).

update_bitlink.title: Update a Bitlink
update_bitlink.description: Change a Bitlink's title, tags, archived flag, destination (long_url — redirecting consumes an encode), expiration, deeplinks or dynamic routing. Only the fields you pass are changed; tags replaces the whole tag list. Returns the updated Bitlink.

domain.description: Domain part of the Bitlink id (the text before the slash), e.g. bit.ly or a branded domain like example.co.

hash.description: Hash part of the Bitlink id (the text after the slash), e.g. 3xYzAbc for bit.ly/3xYzAbc.

archived.description: True to archive (hide) the link, false to unarchive.

dynamic_routing.description: Routing rule objects {long_url, country_match, device_match, os_match, ...}.

delete_bitlink.title: Delete a Bitlink
delete_bitlink.description: Permanently delete a Bitlink. Only works on hash links that have never been edited or redirected; otherwise archive it with update_bitlink.

domain.description: Domain part of the Bitlink id (the text before the slash), e.g. bit.ly or a branded domain like example.co.

hash.description: Hash part of the Bitlink id (the text after the slash), e.g. 3xYzAbc for bit.ly/3xYzAbc.

list_bitlinks.title: List a group's Bitlinks
list_bitlinks.description: Search and page through a group's Bitlinks, newest first, filtered by text, destination host/path, creation time, archive state, tag, campaign or channel. Pass pagination.search_after back to get the next page.

group_guid.description: Group GUID (from list_groups or get_user's default_group_guid).

size.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

search_after.description: Cursor from the previous page's pagination.search_after.

query.description: Free-text search over title, URL and keyword.

hostname_path_query.description: Match destination host and/or path, e.g. example.com/blog.

created_before.description: Only links created before this Unix time (seconds).

created_after.description: Only links created after this Unix time (seconds).

channel_guid.description: Only links in this channel (overrides other filters).

custom_bitlink.description: Filter on whether links have a custom back-half.

has_qr_codes.description: Filter on whether links have QR codes.

has_expiration.description: Filter on whether an expiry is set.

links.description: Bitlink objects with id, link, long_url, title, tags, created_at.

pagination.description: Holds search_after/next for the next page and total.

bulk_update_bitlinks.title: Bulk update Bitlinks
bulk_update_bitlinks.description: Archive/unarchive, or add and remove tags on, up to 100 Bitlinks of a group at once. action=archive uses archive; action=edit_tags uses add_tags/remove_tags. Returns the ids updated.

group_guid.description: Group GUID (from list_groups or get_user's default_group_guid).

links.description: Bitlink ids (domain/hash) to update, up to 100.

archive.description: For action=archive: true to archive, false to unarchive.
